regime_context: Hong Kong theme leadership is thin and defensive: Banks lead with a solid durability bar (0.67) and reasonable breadth (0.69), Energy is the only other robust challenger, and only 4 of 17 themes are eligible — a narrow, quality/income-dominated tape. Momentum is a focus lens only, but the absolute-trend gate is validated on this market (gate_helps=true), so the eligible set is the honest tradable universe; everything below is trend-excluded.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Energy (H-shares) can overtake Banks as the confirmed leader: the rotation margin is 0.33 and Energy's breadth (0.8) is the widest in the eligible set, but the handoff is not confirmed. The watch retires if Energy's rank lags Banks for 10 consecutive sessions, or if the margin widens back above 0.6.

theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks are the confirmed leader, fully eligible under the trend gate, with the strongest durability in the eligible set and breadth around 0.69 — leadership is not a one-name artifact. This is a trend-following lean on the only theme that is simultaneously rank 1, gate-eligible, and above the durability bar; the outperformance is already in place, so the edge is staying-power rather than initiation timing.
evidence: eligible=true under the validated absolute-trend gate
theses.dissent: Banks in HK are rate-sensitive and now crowded in narrative attention; a dovish PBoC surprise or property-NPL headline would unwind a mean-reverting financials bounce that has no fundamental follow-through.

theses.subject: Energy (H-shares)
theses.thesis: Energy is the only viable challenger to Banks: eligible, trending (hurst=trend), and with the best breadth in the entire eligible cohort (0.8). The rotation margin to Banks is narrowing (0.33), so a durable handoff is plausible, but it has not confirmed — treat as a secondary lean on durable trend-health rather than a rotation call.
theses.dissent: H-share energy is one oil-price or global-demand shock away from a breadth collapse; the trend is real but the macro driver is not domestic, making it hostage to commodity beta rather than HK flow.

theses.subject: China Tech & Internet
theses.thesis: China Tech & Internet is the deepest negative-score theme with a scorable proxy and a mean-reverting tag, and — critically — it fails the absolute-trend gate. Since that gate is the one validated edge on this market's history, staying out of an ineligible, mean-reverting laggard is a risk-control lean, not a short call.
evidence: crowding_z -0.83 (out of favor, not oversold signal)
theses.dissent: Mean-reverting tags plus extreme negative crowding occasionally mark a wash-out bottom, and a policy pivot toward platform tech would produce a violent snap-back rally that this avoid stance misses.

falsifier.text: China Tech & Internet theme crosses back above the absolute-trend gate (becomes eligible) and holds above it for 10 straight trading days before the 20-day check-by date
